casting.definitionKo: 연극이나 영화 등에서 배역을 맡을 배우를 정하는 일.
casting.englishDescription: An act of choosing an actor or actress who will play a character in a play, movie, etc.

chimpanzee.definitionKo: 아프리카에 무리를 지어 살며 주로 나뭇잎이나 과일을 따 먹는, 털은 검은 갈색이며 귀가 크고 지능이 발달한 원숭이의 하나.
chimpanzee.englishDescription: A kind of monkey, with black fur and big ears, whose intelligence is highly developed, and which lives in groups in Africa and eats mostly leaves or fruits.

comedienne.definitionKo: 연극이나 텔레비전 프로그램 등에서 우스운 말이나 행동으로 다른 사람을 웃기는 여자.
comedienne.englishDescription: A woman who makes other people laugh using comic words or actions in plays or television programs.

gang.englishDescription: A group of people who commit organized crime.
A group of violent people who commit organized crime.

gap.definitionKo: 서로 다른 두 사람이나 집단, 사물이나 현상 사이에 나타나는 큰 차이.
gap.englishDescription: A pronounced difference between two different people, groups, or phenomena.

label.definitionKo: 어떤 물건에 붙어 그것에 대한 정보를 주는 종이나 천 조각.
label.englishDescription: A piece of paper or cloth attached to an object that gives information about it.

label.definitionKo: 파일을 쉽게 구분하고 정리하기 위하여 적어 붙이는 종이 조각.
label.englishDescription: A piece of paper that is written down and attached to easily sort and organize files.

platform.englishDescription: A designated place at a train station where passengers get on or off a train.

supercomputer.definitionKo: 많은 양의 데이터를 매우 빠른 속도로 처리할 수 있는 컴퓨터.
supercomputer.englishDescription: A computer that can process large amounts of data at very high speeds.

tweezers.definitionKo: 손으로 집기 어려운 물건을 집는 데에 쓰는, 족집게와 비슷한 기구.
tweezers.englishDescription: An implement that looks like pincers, used for picking up objects that are difficult to grasp with the fingers.
